title: [Bug] Compact Fails When Context Window Nearly Full, Requires Restart
body:
**Bug Description**
Compact does not work properly for a couple of days now. When I am at 5% of remaining context window left and I run /compact I get an error that it failed because the conversation is too long. Howver: If I then exit the conversation and run claude --continue + /compact it works on the second try.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 1.0.115
- Feedback ID: 4ac0357e-962c-4ccd-90af-5ee34469b677
author: oborchers
